description.value: Village Pizzeria is a family-owned takeout restaurant that has been baking artisan pizza in Harrison Hot Springs since 1994, using 48-hour aged handmade dough pressed thin and cooked in a traditional deck oven. Situated right behind Harrison Lake and a short walk from Harrison Spa Resort, it sits in the heart of a popular resort town. The menu rounds out with Greek salad, pasta, and chicken wings — a solid refuelling option after a ride into the Hot Springs.

address.value: Unit 101 - 160 Lillooet Ave, Harrison Hot Springs, BC V0M 1K0

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content is fully available and confirms this is a legitimate, active takeout pizza restaurant operating since 1994 at Unit 101-160 Lillooet Ave, Harrison Hot Springs — not Chilliwack as OSM's community tag suggests. OSM takeaway=yes is corroborated by the website's 'Take out Restaurant' label and multiple reviews confirming takeout-only service. No evidence of bike-specific amenities (racks, refill, washrooms) appears anywhere in the website content or OSM tags.
concerns: OSM community tag is 'Chilliwack' but the business address and website clearly place it in Harrison Hot Springs (~60 km east of Chilliwack) — OSM community attribution should be corrected.
OSM record contains no address or phone number; these were sourced entirely from the website.
